title: The Caluma integration is proposed as a joint reference credited to Adfinis, not a Powerhouse-only build
content:
The mechanism is a Caluma workflow event dispatching a typed operation at each form-approval transition — form approval being the unit of work in Caluma, so the record follows the product's own grain rather than being imposed on it.

The distinguishing content is the commercial framing: the integration is proposed as a joint reference integration, credited to Adfinis. That is a different offer from an integration Powerhouse builds and demonstrates on its own. A co-authored reference gives the partner something to point at in their own market, and it makes the credit an explicit term rather than an afterthought.

The single lead is Adfinis AG, headquartered in Bern with Basel, Zurich, DE and NL presence, marked "1 · start here". One other single-lead demo in this slice uses the same joint-reference framing, which suggests it is a deliberate pattern for partners whose own open-source products are the integration surface rather than a one-off concession.
